Moving in Hollywood: What You Need to Know

Moving in Hollywood means checking 3 things: which council covers your address, parking on Alcester Road, and the route into Birmingham. Hollywood sits on the southern edge of Birmingham, in Wythall parish, with Highter's Heath to the north and Wythall village to the south.

Most of Hollywood is in Bromsgrove District, Worcestershire. The northern edge, in Highter's Heath, is inside the City of Birmingham. The council matters for parking permission on move day.

Alcester Road runs through the village, and the A435 now bypasses it. Tell us about driveways, parking and stairs when you ask for a quote, and the quote is built on that access.

Moving into central Birmingham? Hollywood is outside the Birmingham Clean Air Zone (CAZ), which covers the roads inside the A4540 Middleway. Our vans are CAZ compliant, so you pay no CAZ charge on our vehicles at either end.

How Much Do House Removals in Hollywood Cost?

House removals in Hollywood cost from £400 – £700 for a 1-bed house to £1,000 – £1,800 for a 4-bed house, for a local move under 50 miles (80 km). These are guide prices. Your quote is fixed once agreed.

Property sizeGuide price (local move)
1-bed house£400 – £700
2-bed house£600 – £1,000
3-bed house£800 – £1,400
4-bed house£1,000 – £1,800
5+ bed house£1,400 – £2,500+

Smaller jobs are booked by the hour, with a 2-hour minimum: £40 – £60 an hour for 1 man and a van, £60 – £95 for 2 men and a van, and £70 – £110 for 3 men and a Luton van.

Your price depends on 4 factors: the amount you are moving, the distance, access at both addresses, and extras such as packing or storage. Weekend moves cost 10% to 20% more. Month-end dates cost 15% more. Any change in scope is discussed with you before the move.

Property Types We Move in Hollywood

Property types in Hollywood fall into 4 groups: detached houses, semi-detached family homes, bungalows and flats. Name your group on the quote form, and list the rooms in it.

  • 01 Detached houses, such as those along Alcester Road: A detached house move often includes a loft and a garage, so add both to your inventory.
  • 02 Semi-detached family homes: Family home removals load from the driveway or the kerb, so say which one your home has.
  • 03 Bungalows: A bungalow move stays on one level, so the carry from door to van sets the pace.
  • 04 Flats and apartments: Stairs and the walk to the van add time, so give us the floor and the carry distance.

Fully Insured House Removals in Hollywood

Fully insured removals in Hollywood carry Goods in Transit (GIT) cover up to £50,000 and public liability cover up to £5 million.

GIT insurance covers your belongings while they are loaded, moved and unloaded. Public liability insurance applies if someone is hurt or property is damaged on the day.

The GIT policy does not include items you pack yourself or items in storage.

Parking and Completion Day in Hollywood

Parking and completion day in Hollywood both depend on details we ask for in the quote, so share them early.

Parking for the Removal Van

Parking for the removal van in Hollywood starts with one question: which council covers your address. Most Hollywood addresses sit in Bromsgrove District, Worcestershire, so ask your local council there about parking permission.

Addresses on the Highter's Heath side are inside Birmingham, so a Birmingham City Council parking dispensation applies there. Read the council's current terms first.

Mention your parking when you ask for a quote.

If Your Completion Is Delayed

If your completion is delayed, you hear from us by phone or WhatsApp as the day goes on. Ask for storage, if the keys do not arrive.

A small storage unit costs £80 – £150 a month. Compare storage unit prices.

Popular Areas to Live in Hollywood

Popular areas to live in Hollywood include 4 parts of the B47 village and its edges. Hollywood is a large village in Bromsgrove District, almost joined to the south edge of the City of Birmingham.

  • Drakes Cross: The southern part of the village has The Coppice Primary School and Woodrush School.
  • Trueman's Heath: The eastern part of the village carries this name.
  • The Highter's Heath edge: This part sits inside Birmingham, near Hollywood Primary School.
  • Alcester Road: The main road through the village has detached houses along it.

Wythall railway station is about 1.5 km (1 mile) from Drakes Cross, with trains to Birmingham in about 20 minutes.

Hollywood Removal FAQs

How much does a house removal in Hollywood cost?+
A house removal in Hollywood costs £400 – £700 for a 1-bed house, rising to £1,400 – £2,500+ for a 5+ bed house. Those guide prices cover a local move under 50 miles (80 km). Once agreed, the quote stays fixed.
How can I move house cheaply in Hollywood?+
Hire man and van by the hour, with a 2-hour minimum. 1 man and a van costs £40 – £60 an hour, and 2 men and a van cost £60 – £95. See every hourly rate.
How far in advance should I book removals in Hollywood?+
Book removals in Hollywood 2–4 weeks before your moving day, if possible. A short-notice date can still work when a crew is free.
Are my belongings insured during the move?+
Yes. Goods-in-transit insurance covers your belongings up to £50,000, and public liability cover reaches £5 million. Items you pack yourself fall outside the goods-in-transit policy. See what the insurance excludes.
Do you take apart and rebuild furniture?+
Yes. Beds, wardrobes and tables are taken apart at the old home and rebuilt at the new one. List these pieces on your quote request.
Is Hollywood in Birmingham or Worcestershire?+
Both. Most of Hollywood is in Bromsgrove District, Worcestershire, and the Highter's Heath edge is inside Birmingham. Every Hollywood address uses Birmingham as its postal town.
Do you work weekends and bank holidays?+
Yes. Moves run 7 days a week, including weekends and bank holidays. A weekend move costs 10% to 20% more, and a bank holiday move is priced on your quote.
Where can I read reviews of The Royals Removals?+
Read our reviews on Google, where the rating is 5.0, and on Trustpilot. Go to our reviews page.
